name: Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu Gojitsudan - so long
original_name: 旭日ニ戀露ス後日譚・so long
source:
A fandisc after story to the indie game "Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu".
Several years after the Russo-Japanese War, several years after the happy ending of the main characters.
Set in the Taisho era, before the Washington Conference.
[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156862.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
独立游戏“Kyokujitsu ni Kokoro Arawasu”的一个又一个故事的同人光盘。
日俄战争几年后，主角们幸福结局几年后。
故事发生在大正时代，华盛顿会议之前。
[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE156862.html]English DLsite[/url]]
